protocol.data: train_v2 only; test_v1/test_v1c are never read
protocol.split: Union repository groups with identical nontrivial whitespace-stripped code (conservative: also strips whitespace inside literals). Five row-balanced component folds: 0+1 fit, 2 calibrate, 3 select, 4 validate. Bootstrap the same merged components.
protocol.features: Existing context-no-era feature blocks and token hashes; no fitted transform sees held-out rows.
protocol.thresholds: Calibration corpus contract negatives: <=1% high, <=5% medium-or-higher.
protocol.selection: On selection groups, eligible when high FPR <=2%, medium FPR <=7.5%, and fixed high FPR <= baseline +5 percentage points. Maximize real non-info high recall, then medium recall, then minimize fixed high FPR; exact ties retain baseline.
protocol.adoption: On final development-validation groups: at least +3 percentage points real high recall, paired repository-group bootstrap 95% lower bound >0, no medium recall loss, high FPR <=max(1.5%,baseline+0.2pp), medium FPR <=max(6%,baseline+0.5pp), and fixed high FPR <=baseline+3pp. Otherwise retain baseline. This is not a new sealed-test result.

limitation: Training-only development split, not an independent sealed benchmark; no production artifact changed.

feature_cache.limitation: Reused legacy cache; its key omits train_classic_v2.py. Current trainer and feature-loop hashes are recorded separately.

audit_appendix.timing: Appended after completed run; all model parameters, scores, thresholds, selection, CI and acceptance decisions unchanged.
audit_appendix.changes: Recorded dependency/cache/runtime hashes. Final trainer adds provenance, paired group counts, fresh output directory support and overwrite refusal.
audit_appendix.paired_counts_limitation: Executed trainer did not persist per-component hit counts or baseline predictions; recorded CI cannot be independently recomputed without deterministic baseline refit. Final trainer records counts for future runs.
audit_appendix.baseline_scope: Retrained ctx_fixed_noera classical component; not a comparison against the deployed classical-plus-LLM ensemble.
